sn24.37:1.2: Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kim abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati ||
sn24.37:1.3: Rūpī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti || || 4
sn24.37:2.1: Rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpam upādāya rūpam abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati ||
sn24.37:2.2: Rūpī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti || || 6-9
sn24.37:2.6: Viññāṇe sati viññāṇam upādāya viññāṇam abhinivissa evam diṭṭhi uppajjati ||
sn24.37:2.7: Rūpī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti || || 10
sn24.37:3.1: Taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave Rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn24.37:3.3: Vipariṇāmadhammam api nu tam anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya
sn24.37:3.4: Rūpī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti || ||
sn24.37:3.10: Iti kho bhikkhave dukkhe sati dukkham upādāya dukkham abhinivissa evam diṭṭhi uppajjati
sn24.37:3.11: Rūpī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti || || 1-3
